children: MASK, a meme coin on Solana, briefly pushed its market capitalization above $31 million and set a record high. According to Odaily, the token rose more than 260% over the past 24 hours before easing to $20.2 million.
Odaily also reminded users that meme coin prices are highly volatile and advised investors to participate cautiously.

title: MASK Meme Coin on Solana Briefly Tops $31 Million Market Cap, Hits Record High
